About.heroDescription: WatchTower en kanyakla mar rieko mar oganda ma tiyo gi AI kod teknolojia mag dhok mag alworni mondo omi ji nyal ripodho gik motimore, masira, kod ketho mag ratiro e dhogi giwegi, kendo loko ripodhogo obed ngʼeyo minyalo tiyego ne miyo luor kod dwoko wach.
About.objectiveDescription: Sirruok ni ngʼato ka ngʼato nigi teko mar ripodho gik motimore e oganda e dhok mowuoyego, mondo onge dwol ma ok owinji kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato nyalo riwo lwete e miyo joma nigi diragruok luor.
About.languagesDescription: WatchTower sani konyo dhok {count} mondo omi dwond oganda mangʼeny nyal riwo lwete, winji, kendo kony e miyo luor e dhok ma giparo ni owinjorene moloyo.
About.safetyDescription: Wangʼeyo ni wuoyo nyalo kelo masira. Ma e kaka WatchTower ogero mondo orit.
About.faqIdentityQuestion: Be ng'eyo mara orit ka aoro ripodho?
About.faqIdentityAnswer: Ok onego ichiw nyingi, namba mar simu, kata fweny moro amora manyiso ngʼeyo mondo ior ripodho. Pondo en gima jare, ok gima opogore.
About.faqAccountAnswer: Onge profael mar chweyo kata donjo ma iluwo. Ibiro, ior ripodho, iwuok. Onge gima tweyi gi gima ioro.
About.faqEncryptionQuestion: Be gima aoro nyalo yudore ka odwogo ira?
About.faqEncryptionAnswer: Gik duto miorogo osiegi chakre sa ma iorogo. Ripodhi ok nyal manege kata dwokore iri e kinde mar oro.
About.faqVisibilityAnswer: Ripodhi nonre mana gi jorito mag WatchTower mosir. Gima ioro ok opog e lela gi fweny moro amora manyiso ngʼeyo.
About.faqDeviceQuestion: Be anyalo ripodho koa e gir tiyo moriw kata mar ji duto?
About.faqDeviceAnswer: Ee. WatchTower ok kan fweny mag sesheni kata cookies motwere gi gima ioro. Ripodho koa e gir tiyo moriw ok ket e masira.
About.ctaDescription: Or ripodh gima notimore e dhogi. Onge akaunt madwarore, onge fweny mari giwegi madwarore.

Footer.brandDescription: Miyo oganda teko mar ripodho gik mag oganda e dhogi giwegi, mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato riwre e ngima mar oganda kod miyo joma nigi diragruok luor.

Home.heroDescription: Watchtower miyo ji teko mar ripodho weche mag alworni kod ketho mag ratiro e dhok ma giwuoyogo mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato riwre e ngima mar oganda kod miyo joma nigi diragruok luor.
Home.howItWorksDescription: Koa e ripodho achiel nyaka lokruok maduongʼ, ma e kaka WatchTower miyo oganda teko mar winjre kendo kelo lokruok makelo tich.
Home.step1Description: Wachiwo teknolojia makonyo ji kod oganda ripodho weche mag oganda kata ketho mag ratiro tir koa e simu kata kompyuta e dhok ma giwuoyogo.
Home.step2Description: Wanono kendo wasiro ripodho ka ripodho, ka waketo gik motimore e ramaki kendo wanyiso kit wach mane dhi bedo mopondo. Fweny manoko lokore ngʼeyo maler kendo mochanore maber manyiso wach maduongʼ.
Home.step3Description: Oganda, riwruok, kod kanyakla yudo ngʼeyogi mondo giger weche, gimi joma nigi diragruok luor, kendo gidhi nyime gi lokruok makelo tich, kotenore gi ranyisi madier koa e piny.
Home.speakNaturallyDescription: Watchtower ondiko, oloko kendo ochiko ripodh moro amora mondo wach owinjre, kata ripodh rnotim e dho mane.
Home.insightsHeading: Paro, sigandini kod ngʼerono makin goto.
Home.insightsDescription: Ne moko e yo moro amora mar ripodho mag oganda, chiro muom, teku mar dhok mangʼeny kod kaka wach maber nyalo konyo timo gik madongo.
Home.insightsFallback1Title: Angʼo momiyo dwond ji mar polo tek e winjo gik ma timore e piny
Home.insightsFallback2Title: Goyo kendo lingʼe mar dhok e ripodho mag oganda
Home.insightsFallback3Title: Koa e ripodho mag ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka e weche madongo
Home.faqsDescription: Ngʼe moloyo kuom ripodho, dhok, penjo mar wich kuot kod kaka Watchtower konyo mondo wach mag oganda obed motiyo.
Home.faq1Answer: Watchtower en gima tiyoe e ripodho mag dhok mangʼeny kendo e winjo gik malosore e piny, miyo ji teko mar ripodho weche mag alworni kod ketho mag ratiro e dhok ma giwuoyogo. Ripodho mondo ongor, oikel e karta kendo olok chuth mondo ngʼere gik ma timore kendo kony timo gik madongo.
Home.faq2Answer: Inyalo ripodho gik ma timore kaka ketho mag ratiro, chandruok mar ranyisi kod weche mamoko mag alworni motimore e oganda mari — gimoro amora ma jomoko onego ngʼe kata manyalo konyo e winjo kaka ichalo.
Home.faq3Answer: Ee. Inyalo ripodho ka iwuoyo kata ka indiko e dho ma in gi yie kode, kendo Watchtower konyo ndiko, loko kendo chiko ripodhi mond owinjre e dhok duto.
Home.faq4Question: Inyalo keto ripodhi ka ok ingʼere?
Home.faq4Answer: Ee. Kik ngʼer kata bedo ma ongʼere en a rane, ok an ranyis — in bende ok nyaka mi nyingi kata wach moro amora ma nyalo nyisoe ngʼa in mondo iripodh.
Home.faq5Answer: Ripodh moro amora nyalo nengore kendo oketi e karta kod mamoko mond owinjre timbe, kendo omiyo ogendini, chuni gi udi mamoko ma nyalo tiyo kuome.
Home.impactDescription: Nonuru kaka oganda winjre, keto paro, kendo kelo lokruok.
Home.ctaDescription: Chak ripodho gik motimore gi Watchtower, kata nonro ngʼeyo mag sa moro amora e ramaki mawa.
Home.missionStatement: Watchtower konyo oganda ripodho gik matimore, ngʼeyo kit weche e ripodho, kendo loko fweny koa e piny obed ngʼeyo makonyo tich.
Home.exploreDescription: Nonuru ripodho kuom kuonde, weche, dhok, kod sa mondo ungʼe gik matimore e piny.
